title: R.F.K. Jr. Sends a Message on Vaccines

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在清晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空中走过七个十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗星星的背后是什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代冰淇淋。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联赛中最好的球队。

I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天使用不同的起始单词。

And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢一锅端食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，持续助您理解世界并充分过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅即可享受特别优惠，网址为nytimes.com斜杠subscribe。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴瓦罗，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, the Trump administration bypassed the traditional system of vaccine guidance and abruptly ended the government's recommendation
sentences.zh: 周二，特朗普政府绕过了传统的疫苗指导系统，突然取消了政府的建议

sentences.en: that two key groups of Americans get vaccinated against COVID.
sentences.zh: 即建议两类关键的美国人群接种新冠疫苗。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Apoorva Mondevili, on what could be a turning point moment in public health.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事阿普尔瓦·蒙德维利将探讨这可能是公共卫生领域的一个转折点。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, May 28th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月28日，星期三。

sentences.en: Apoorva, we just got some very big public health news here in the United States in the form of this video that came out on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 阿普尔瓦，我们刚刚在美国这里获得了一些非常重大的公共卫生新闻，形式就是周二发布的那段视频。

sentences.en: Hi, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: I'm Robert F.
sentences.zh: 我是小罗伯特·F·

sentences.en: Kennedy Jr., your HHS secretary.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪，你们的卫生与公众服务部部长。

sentences.en: And I'm here today with NIH director.
sentences.zh: 我今天和国立卫生研究院局长在一起。

sentences.en: So Tuesday morning, Robert F.
sentences.zh: 所以在周二早上，小罗伯特·F·

sentences.en: Kennedy Jr., our health secretary, dropped this very big piece of news via a tweet.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪，我们的卫生部长，通过一条推文发布了这条重大消息。

sentences.en: I couldn't be more pleased to announce that as of today.
sentences.zh: 我非常高兴地宣布，从今天开始。

sentences.en: He said that he couldn't be more pleased.
sentences.zh: 他说他感到非常高兴。

sentences.en: Those are his words.
sentences.zh: 这是他的原话。

sentences.en: That he was announcing...
sentences.zh: 他宣布……

sentences.en: The COVID vaccine for healthy children and healthy pregnant women has been removed from the CDC-recommended immunization schedule.
sentences.zh: 针对健康儿童和健康孕妇的新冠疫苗已被从疾控中心推荐的免疫接种日程中移除。

sentences.en: That the CDC's immunization schedule, which recommends who should get shots and when, would no longer include COVID shots for healthy kids and healthy pregnant women.
sentences.zh: 即疾控中心的免疫接种日程（该日程建议谁应该接种疫苗以及何时接种）将不再把针对健康儿童和健康孕妇的新冠疫苗包含在内。

sentences.en: Last year, the Biden administration urged healthy children to get yet another COVID shot, despite the lack of any clinical data, to support the repeat booster strategy in children.
sentences.zh: 去年，尽管缺乏任何临床数据来支持针对儿童的重复加强针策略，拜登政府仍敦促健康儿童接种又一针新冠疫苗。

sentences.en: And he went out of his way to say, you know, the Biden administration has been recommending this shot and there's no clinical data to support its use.
sentences.zh: 而且他特意指出，你知道，拜登政府一直在推荐这种疫苗，但没有任何临床数据支持其使用。

sentences.en: And that...
sentences.zh: 并且……

sentences.en: We're now one step closer to realizing President Trump's promise to make America healthy again.
sentences.zh: 我们现在距离实现特朗普总统让美国再次健康的承诺又近了一步。

sentences.en: Produced by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 由美国

sentences.en: Department of Health and Human Services.
sentences.zh: 卫生与公众服务部制作。

sentences.en: It was essentially this very short announcement of a very, very big public health policy.
sentences.zh: 这基本上就是对一项非常、非常重大的公共卫生政策的极简短宣布。

sentences.en: And I think people are extremely confused.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为人们感到极其困惑。

sentences.en: The experts I've talked to even are very confused about what this means in terms of access, if people want to get the shot.
sentences.zh: 甚至我交谈过的专家们，对于如果人们想要接种疫苗，这在获取渠道上意味着什么也感到非常困惑。

sentences.en: And they're also very confused about the process, because this is not how the FDA normally delivers policy announcements.
sentences.zh: 他们对这个流程也感到非常困惑，因为这并非FDA发布政策公告的正常方式。

sentences.en: They don't just post it on Twitter.
sentences.zh: 他们不会直接把它发在推特上。

sentences.en: There's a whole protocol with many, many, many, many steps before they arrive at something like this.
sentences.zh: 在达成类似的事情之前，有一整套包含非常、非常、非常、非常多步骤的规程。

sentences.en: Some of those quite important.
sentences.zh: 其中一些相当重要。

sentences.en: And none of that happened here.
sentences.zh: 而这里什么都没有发生。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Well, we're going to get to all the ways in which this process was singular, exceptional, unusual.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们将探讨这个流程表现得独特、非同寻常、不合常规的种种方式。

sentences.en: I think to put it all into context, as a public health guideline, we should begin by understanding what has been the government's recommendation for COVID vaccines up until now,
sentences.zh: 我认为为了全面看待这一切，作为一项公共卫生准则，我们应该首先了解直到目前为止政府对新冠疫苗的建议是什么，

sentences.en: when obviously it just changed.
sentences.zh: 而显然它刚刚改变了。

sentences.en: So up until now, the CDC has recommended COVID shots for everybody six months and older.
sentences.zh: 因此，直到现在，疾控中心一直建议六个月及以上的所有人接种新冠疫苗。

sentences.en: So any child, regardless of health status, any adult, pregnant women, older adults, everybody.
sentences.zh: 所以任何儿童，无论健康状况如何，任何成年人、孕妇、老年人，所有人。

sentences.en: And the idea was that the benefit from the vaccines, even if it has been dwindling,
sentences.zh: 其理念是，疫苗带来的益处——即使一直在减弱——

sentences.en: still outweighs any risk from the vaccine and certainly is very important given the risk of COVID.
sentences.zh: 仍然超过了疫苗的任何风险，而且鉴于新冠的风险，它当然非常重要。

sentences.en: And so that's where the CDC has been pretty much since these shots were available to those groups of people.
sentences.zh: 这就是疾控中心自这些疫苗向这些群体开放以来的基本立场。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So this is the biggest by far change in the government's guidelines pretty much since the vaccine became widely available.
sentences.zh: 所以，这可以说是自疫苗广泛上市以来，政府指南中迄今为止最大的一次改变。

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And what does it mean for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么，从实际操作层面来说，美国

sentences.en: government to stop recommending a vaccine for a particular group, practically speaking?
sentences.zh: 政府停止推荐某个特定群体接种疫苗意味着什么？

sentences.en: Like what actually changes?
sentences.zh: 比如实际发生了什么变化？

sentences.en: Generally speaking, what it means is when the CDC's advisors recommend a vaccine, that's when insurance companies are required to cover it.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，这意味着当疾控中心的顾问推荐一种疫苗时，保险公司就被要求予以报销。

sentences.en: So if a vaccine falls off the CDC's recommended immunization schedule,
sentences.zh: 因此，如果某种疫苗从疾控中心推荐的免疫接种日程中剔除，

sentences.en: insurance companies are highly unlikely to cover it unless they make the decision that somebody getting sick from COVID will cost them more money.
sentences.zh: 保险公司极不可能对其进行报销，除非他们断定某人感染新冠生病会让他们花费更多金钱。

sentences.en: So there is a possibility they could still cover it.
sentences.zh: 所以仍有一种可能性他们会继续报销。

sentences.en: But practically speaking, what it does mean is that low-income families may not be able to get the shot.
sentences.zh: 但从实际操作来看，这确实意味着低收入家庭可能无法接种疫苗。

sentences.en: There are a lot of practical hurdles that not having the CDC's stamp of approval on something like this means in the real world, especially in our health care system.
sentences.zh: 在现实世界中，缺乏疾控中心对这类事情的背书会带来很多现实障碍，尤其是在我们的医疗保健系统中。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about these two categories of people who are now being told that they do not need this vaccine.
sentences.zh: 好吧，让我们来谈谈这两类现在被告知不需要这种疫苗的人群。

sentences.en: And from everything you've just said, we'll now probably have a harder time getting it if they wanted it.
sentences.zh: 根据你刚才所说的一切，如果他们想要接种，现在可能更难获得了。

sentences.en: And let's begin with healthy children and why the government is saying healthy children should not necessarily be getting the COVID vaccine any longer.
sentences.zh: 让我们从健康儿童开始，为什么政府说健康儿童不一定非要再接种新冠疫苗？

sentences.en: What's the thinking there?
sentences.zh: 这背后的考量是什么？

sentences.en: The thinking there is that we have seen decreasing numbers of severely ill children, hospitalizations, deaths from COVID.
sentences.zh: 背后的考量是，我们看到因新冠而重病、住院、死亡的儿童数量在不断减少。

sentences.en: It's not zero.
sentences.zh: 数字并非为零。

sentences.en: I will say that the number of kids who have died from COVID is on par with what happens in an average flu season.
sentences.zh: 我要说的是，因新冠死亡的儿童数量与平均流感季中发生的情况相当。

sentences.en: So there are still some children dying from COVID.
sentences.zh: 所以仍然有一些儿童死于新冠。

sentences.en: But what the government is saying is that we don't think that those numbers are high enough and we don't think this is a risk enough that we should be getting healthy children to get the shot.
sentences.zh: 但政府所说的是，我们认为这些数字不够高，我们认为这构成的风险不足以让我们敦促健康儿童去接种疫苗。

sentences.en: Now, their thinking is that only children who have another medical condition that puts them at severe risk are going to end up in the hospital.
sentences.zh: 现在他们的想法是，只有那些患有其他使其面临严重风险的潜在疾病的儿童最终才会住院。

sentences.en: And I will say it is consistent with what a lot of other countries have decided that they don't necessarily need to recommend vaccines to healthy kids.
sentences.zh: 我要说的是，这与许多其他国家所做出的决定是一致的，即他们不一定需要向健康儿童推荐疫苗。

sentences.en: Even the World Health Organization says kids don't need to get a shot of COVID vaccine unless they have another serious condition.
sentences.zh: 甚至世界卫生组织也表示，除非儿童患有其他严重疾病，否则不需要接种新冠疫苗。

sentences.en: So that part is not entirely unusual.
sentences.zh: 所以这部分并非完全不寻常。

sentences.en: What is really unclear and surprising, if it's true, is that they don't seem to be making a distinction for kids who have never been vaccinated for COVID.
sentences.zh: 真正不清楚且令人惊讶的是，如果这是真的的话，他们似乎没有为从未接种过新冠疫苗的儿童做出区分。

sentences.en: Those are the kids who would be at most risk from the disease.
sentences.zh: 这些正是面临该疾病最大风险的儿童。

sentences.en: We know that kids under two tend to be really vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 我们知道两岁以下的儿童往往非常脆弱。

sentences.en: And they did not seem to make an exception for kids who might need to get this for the first time.
sentences.zh: 而且他们似乎没有为可能需要首次接种此疫苗的儿童设立例外规定。

sentences.en: Let me just make sure I understand.
sentences.zh: 让我确认一下我是否理解准确。

sentences.en: The new guidelines do not distinguish between a first-time vaccine and boosters, you're saying.
sentences.zh: 你是说，新的指南没有区分初次接种疫苗和加强针。

sentences.en: It seems so.
sentences.zh: 似乎如此。

sentences.en: Again, I'm saying it seems so because there was not enough detail in that video announcement to be clear.
sentences.zh: 再次说明，我说似乎如此是因为那段视频公告中的细节不够明确。

sentences.en: And they have not responded to questions to clarify that.
sentences.zh: 而且他们也没有回应澄清这一点的提问。

sentences.en: But at the moment, yeah, it looks like they are saying no COVID vaccine for healthy kids regardless of whether they've had any shots previously.
sentences.zh: 但目前来看，是的，这看起来他们是在表示健康儿童无需接种新冠疫苗，无论他们以前是否接种过任何疫苗。

sentences.en: And why does that first vaccine matter relative to a booster, which I'm guessing matters potentially a little bit less?
sentences.zh: 为什么相对于加强针而言，这第一针疫苗很重要？我猜加强针的重要性可能相对略低一点？

sentences.en: It matters because we know that kids under two are the most vulnerable to COVID.
sentences.zh: 它很重要，因为我们知道两岁以下的儿童对新冠最脆弱。

sentences.en: When you look at the hospitalization numbers for very young kids, they're on par with the hospitalizations for older adults.
sentences.zh: 当你查看极幼童的住院人数时，他们与老年人的住院人数相当。

sentences.en: If you look at 65 plus.
sentences.zh: 如果你看65岁及以上的人群。

sentences.en: And so that age group is at risk.
sentences.zh: 所以那个年龄段面临风险。

sentences.en: And, you know, the vaccine is not approved for kids under six months.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，该疫苗未获准用于六个月以下的儿童。

sentences.en: But those kids might be protected from their mothers getting vaccinated when pregnant.
sentences.zh: 但这些儿童可能会通过母亲在怀孕期间接种疫苗而受到保护。

sentences.en: So this age group of between six months and two years,
sentences.zh: 所以六个月到两岁之间的这个年龄段，

sentences.en: some pediatricians say it's like very important for that age group for their first exposure to COVID to be through this vaccine and not to the virus itself.
sentences.zh: 一些儿科医生表示，对于这个年龄段来说，他们第一次接触新冠病毒最好是通过这种疫苗，而不是通过病毒本身，这非常重要。

sentences.en: Because that could be really dangerous for them.
sentences.zh: 因为那对他们来说可能真的很危险。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And why would the CDC suddenly not recommend that first, I guess some people call it primary vaccination against COVID for a child?
sentences.zh: 为什么疾控中心会突然不建议儿童接种那第一剂（我想有人称之为基础免疫）新冠疫苗？

sentences.en: I know you're saying that they might later clarify.
sentences.zh: 我知道你刚才说他们可能以后会澄清。

sentences.en: But if the thinking right now is that they're not recommending that, why wouldn't they recommend that?
sentences.zh: 但如果现在的想法是不推荐，他们为什么不推荐呢？

sentences.en: Well, I think the people who are in charge now, and that's, you know, RFK Jr., but also Marty Makari, who heads the FDA, and Bina Prasad,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为现在掌权的人——你知道，小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪，还有领导FDA的马蒂·马卡里，以及比娜·普拉萨德，

sentences.en: who now heads the vaccine and drug approval process at the FDA.
sentences.zh: 她现在负责FDA的疫苗和药物审批流程。

sentences.en: They have all been quite clear that they don't think that COVID vaccines are necessary for kids.
sentences.zh: 他们都非常明确地表示，他们认为儿童没有必要接种新冠疫苗。

sentences.en: And actually, in May 2021, when COVID was still a huge issue, RFK Jr.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在2021年5月新冠仍然是一个巨大问题时，小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪

sentences.en: filed a petition with the FDA demanding that the agency rescind its authorization for the shots.
sentences.zh: 曾向FDA提交了一份请愿书，要求该机构撤销对这些疫苗的授权。

sentences.en: And then the next year, he also tried to stop them from approving the shots for children.
sentences.zh: 然后在第二年，他还试图阻止他们批准儿童接种疫苗。

sentences.en: So we know he's not a fan of this vaccine for kids.
sentences.zh: 所以我们知道他不是儿童疫苗的拥趸。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And is there any risk to those very young kids from getting the vaccine that we have learned about since the vaccine was authorized that might lie behind this new recommendation?
sentences.zh: 自从疫苗获批以来，我们所了解到的极幼童接种疫苗是否存在任何可能成为这一新建议背后的风险？

sentences.en: I don't think so.
sentences.zh: 我不这么认为。

sentences.en: You know, there are millions and millions of kids all over the world have gotten this vaccine.
sentences.zh: 你知道，全世界有数以百万计的儿童接种了这种疫苗。

sentences.en: And I've talked to FDA officials before.
sentences.zh: 我以前和FDA的官员交谈过。

sentences.en: I've talked to vaccine safety people at the European Medicines Agency and the CDC.
sentences.zh: 我与欧洲药品管理局和疾控中心的疫苗安全人员交谈过。

sentences.en: And all of the studies show the vaccine to be pretty safe in kids.
sentences.zh: 所有的研究都表明该疫苗在儿童中相当安全。

sentences.en: There is that risk of heart problems in boys above a certain age, above 12.
sentences.zh: 在某个特定年龄以上的男孩中，也就是12岁以上，确实存在心脏问题的风险。

sentences.en: But really, in the age group of kids that we're talking about here who are at high risk from COVID, there have not been any safety concerns that I'm aware of.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，在我们这里讨论的面临新冠高风险的儿童年龄段中，据我所知没有任何安全隐患。

sentences.en: So the argument would simply seem to be that it's not helping enough people to be worth children getting this vaccine and the risk isn't high enough.
sentences.zh: 所以其论点似乎很简单，即它没有产生足够的帮助，不值得让儿童冒着风险接种这种疫苗，而且风险也不够高。

sentences.en: So why do it?
sentences.zh: 那为什么还要接种？

sentences.en: Correct.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So what's going to happen to a parent who wants to give their kid a vaccine for all the reasons you just suggested?
sentences.zh: 那么，出于你刚刚提到的种种原因，想要给孩子接种疫苗的家长会怎么样？

sentences.en: They're going to go to their pediatrician, presumably, and say, I know that recommendation has changed, but I would still like my kid to get this vaccine.
sentences.zh: 他们大概会去找他们的儿科医生，并说，我知道建议已经改变了，但我仍然希望我的孩子接种这种疫苗。

sentences.en: What is going to be the likely response?
sentences.zh: 可能的反应会是什么？

sentences.en: Well, it's very important to remember that they did leave the door open for kids with other health conditions.
sentences.zh: 嗯，非常重要的一点是要记住，他们确实为患有其他健康状况的儿童留了一扇门。

sentences.en: So a lot depends on that kid's health status.
sentences.zh: 所以这很大程度上取决于那个孩子的健康状况。

sentences.en: If the pediatrician feels the kid is healthy and agrees with the FDA, it's a good chance the parent is not going to be able to get the shot.
sentences.zh: 如果儿科医生觉得孩子很健康并且同意FDA的看法，家长很有可能无法接种到疫苗。

sentences.en: But if the kid does have asthma or is obese or has juvenile diabetes,
sentences.zh: 但如果孩子确实患有哮喘、肥胖或青少年糖尿病，

sentences.en: then they might still be able to get the shot from their pediatrician and not have to travel too far to get it from someplace that offers it.
sentences.zh: 那么他们可能仍然可以从儿科医生那里获得疫苗，而不必跑太远去提供该服务的其他地方接种。

sentences.en: The problem is when you start putting in these kinds of limitations on the eligibility, the availability of the vaccine just naturally goes down.
sentences.zh: 问题在于，当你开始对资格施加这种限制时，疫苗的可及性自然就会下降。

sentences.en: The number of pediatricians who carry it, the number of pharmacies who carry it all starts to go down.
sentences.zh: 备有疫苗的儿科医生数量、备有疫苗的药房数量都会开始下降。

sentences.en: So it just becomes harder for people to get it.
sentences.zh: 所以人们获取它只是变得更加困难了。

sentences.en: Hard, not impossible, but hard.
sentences.zh: 困难，并非不可能，但很难。

sentences.en: Let's turn to pregnant women.
sentences.zh: 让我们转向孕妇。

sentences.en: What do we understand motivated this change in recommendations?
sentences.zh: 我们认为是什么动机促成了这一建议的改变？

sentences.en: This one was a lot more unexpected and really quite confusing.
sentences.zh: 这一个更加出乎意料，而且确实相当令人困惑。

sentences.en: There's a lot of data saying that pregnant women are at much higher risk of COVID than non-pregnant women of the same age.
sentences.zh: 有大量数据表明，孕妇感染新冠的风险远高于同龄的非孕妇。

sentences.en: So it's not clear why they suddenly have taken off the recommendation.
sentences.zh: 所以目前尚不清楚他们为什么会突然取消这一建议。

sentences.en: Can you remind us why that is?
sentences.zh: 你能提醒我们为什么会这样吗？

sentences.en: There are a lot of studies showing that pregnant women, when they get COVID, they have a higher risk of miscarriage and stillbirth.
sentences.zh: 有许多研究表明，孕妇感染新冠后，流产和死产的风险更高。

sentences.en: They can develop preeclampsia.
sentences.zh: 她们可能会患上子痫前期。

sentences.en: They have a higher risk of hospitalization.
sentences.zh: 她们住院的风险更高。

sentences.en: They're at higher risk of dying.
sentences.zh: 她们死亡的风险更高。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we've seen that from the very beginning, from the early days of COVID.
sentences.zh: 我们从一开始、从新冠的早期阶段就看到了这一点。

sentences.en: And so there was actually a real sort of urgency to get the vaccines approved for pregnant women.
sentences.zh: 所以，实际上非常迫切地需要批准孕妇使用疫苗。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: You had suggested earlier that children under the age of six months who have never been eligible for a COVID vaccine
sentences.zh: 你刚才提到，六个月以下、从未符合接种新冠疫苗条件的儿童

sentences.en: have acquired immunity from their moms getting the vaccine, I suppose, in utero, essentially, right?
sentences.zh: 我想，基本上是通过他们的妈妈在子宫里接种疫苗获得了免疫力，对吧？

sentences.en: So what now do we think happens if that recommendation is gone to babies between the ages of birth and six months old?
sentences.zh: 那么现在，如果针对出生到六个月大婴儿的这项建议取消了，我们认为会发生什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a very scary proposition in some ways because those babies are actually at the highest risk from COVID.
sentences.zh: 是的，在某些方面这是一个非常可怕的假设，因为这些婴儿实际上是感染新冠风险最高的人群。

sentences.en: And one of the reasons for vaccinating pregnant women is to protect those babies passively.
sentences.zh: 为孕妇接种疫苗的原因之一，就是为了被动保护这些婴儿。

sentences.en: You know, you vaccinate the mother and the antibodies go through to the fetus and then the baby's protected for maybe the first few months of life
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你给母亲接种疫苗，抗体就会穿过胎盘进入胎儿体内，然后婴儿在生命的头几个月里就能受到保护

sentences.en: until, you know, six months when the baby can get its own vaccine.
sentences.zh: 直到，你知道的，六个月大时婴儿可以接种自己的疫苗。

sentences.en: And so to not have that protection really puts those newborns at risk of COVID.
sentences.zh: 因此，没有了这种保护，确实会让这些新生儿面临感染新冠的风险。

sentences.en: And, you know, their airways are not well-developed.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，他们的呼吸道发育并不完善。

sentences.en: So a respiratory infection in a newborn is a pretty big deal.
sentences.zh: 所以新生儿患上呼吸道感染可是一件大事。

sentences.en: And so this policy is going to leave newborns open to COVID.
sentences.zh: 因此，这项政策将使新生儿暴露在新冠病毒的威胁之下。

sentences.en: What has been the reaction from the doctors who treat pregnant women?
sentences.zh: 治疗孕妇的医生们对此有何反应？

sentences.en: They are so worried.
sentences.zh: 他们非常担忧。

sentences.en: And, you know, the experts I've talked to have said they're very disappointed.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我交谈过的专家们都表示他们非常失望。

sentences.en: The American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists said it's really unhappy about this decision.
sentences.zh: 美国妇产科医师学会表示，对这一决定感到非常不满。

sentences.en: You know, I also spoke to somebody who regulates vaccines for the European Union.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我还与一位负责欧盟疫苗监管的人士交谈过。

sentences.en: And he said, you know, he could sort of get behind the kids' decision.
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道的，他某种程度上能理解关于儿童的决定。

sentences.en: He could see that maybe not all healthy kids need the vaccine, but that it was still really important to vaccinate pregnant women.
sentences.zh: 他能理解也许并非所有健康的儿童都需要接种疫苗，但为孕妇接种疫苗仍然非常重要。

sentences.en: So that part of this announcement saying healthy pregnant women shouldn't get the vaccine anymore, that's really thrown a lot of experts for a loop.
sentences.zh: 因此，公告中说健康的孕妇不应再接种疫苗的那部分内容，确实让许多专家感到大惑不解。

sentences.en: And they're quite angry about it because the data that they're familiar with says that there is a benefit and that kids should continue to get the vaccine
sentences.zh: 他们对此相当愤怒，因为他们熟悉的数据表明疫苗是有益的，儿童应该继续接种疫苗

sentences.en: and pregnant women especially should continue to get the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 尤其是孕妇更应该继续接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And so they're left wondering if this is not based on science at all and if it's politically motivated.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们不禁琢磨这是否完全不是基于科学，而是出于政治动机。

sentences.en: And that makes them very nervous about what else is going to get caught up in this kind of decision making.
sentences.zh: 这让他们对还有什么会被卷入这种决策过程感到非常不安。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是韦娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写“连线”（Connections）游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏板块的字谜之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你们。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天负责创作“拼写蜜蜂”（Spelling Bee）游戏和“字母箱”（Letterboxd）。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做色联觉的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到声音的这些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com slash games，今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Apoorva, you started to hint at this at the beginning of our conversation, but I think we really need to understand how Robert F.
sentences.zh: 阿普尔瓦，你在我们对话开始时就暗示了这一点，但我认为我们真的需要了解小罗伯特·F·

sentences.en: Kennedy Jr.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪

sentences.en: and the Trump administration went around the normal procedures for announcing a change like this, of this scale.
sentences.zh: 以及特朗普政府是如何绕过正常程序来宣布这种规模的此类变更的。

sentences.en: Okay, so just let me geek out a little bit on how the process normally works.
sentences.zh: 好的，那我就稍微以极客的角度讲讲这个流程通常是如何运作的。

sentences.en: Please.
sentences.zh: 请讲。

sentences.en: Usually when you have a vaccine, the FDA will look at all of the data on its safety and effectiveness that the companies present.
sentences.zh: 通常当你有一种疫苗时，FDA会审查公司提交的所有关于其安全性和有效性的数据。

sentences.en: And its advisors talk about the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 其顾问们会讨论该疫苗。

sentences.en: And then the FDA makes a decision.
sentences.zh: 然后FDA做出决定。

sentences.en: It says, okay, the vaccine is safe and effective and it approves it or not.
sentences.zh: 它会说，好吧，这种疫苗是安全有效的，并予以批准或不予批准。

sentences.en: Let's say it approves the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 假设它批准了该疫苗。

sentences.en: Then there are scientific advisors to the CDC who are more clinical, you know, or more sort of on the medical side, who are doctors.
sentences.zh: 接着，CDC会有一些科学顾问，他们更多是临床方面的，你知道的，或者是更偏向医疗方面的医生。

sentences.en: They will look at all of the data and they talk about it all.
sentences.zh: 他们会查看所有数据并进行全面讨论。

sentences.en: And then they make a recommendation on who should get the vaccine that the FDA has said is safe and effective.
sentences.zh: 然后，他们会针对谁应该接种FDA已认定安全有效的疫苗提出建议。

sentences.en: So they make the clinical decisions of who should get the vaccine, when they should get it, should they get it with other shots or should they get it by itself, etc.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们会做出临床决策：谁应该接种疫苗、何时接种、是否应与其他疫苗一起接种还是单独接种等。

sentences.en: So that's a series of steps and eventually ends with the CDC director accepting or modifying what the CDC advisor said.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一系列步骤，最终以CDC主任接受或修改CDC顾问的意见告终。

sentences.en: And then it becomes sort of official recommendation.
sentences.zh: 然后这就会成为一种官方建议。

sentences.en: CDC does not make rules or laws.
sentences.zh: CDC不制定规章或法律。

sentences.en: It just makes recommendations.
sentences.zh: 它只提出建议。

sentences.en: And then the states can decide what they do with those recommendations.
sentences.zh: 然后各州可以决定如何处理这些建议。

sentences.en: And it's the states that decide, okay, if a kid wants to enter kindergarten, these are all the vaccines that the kid who lives in this state must have had.
sentences.zh: 正是各州来决定，好吧，如果一个孩子想要上幼儿园，这些就是生活在这个州的孩子必须接种过的所有疫苗。

sentences.en: Right now for COVID, there are no states that mandate the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 目前对于新冠疫苗，没有任何一个州强制接种。

sentences.en: Let's just get that out there.
sentences.zh: 我们先把这一点明确一下。

sentences.en: So we're just talking about recommendations right now.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在讨论的只是建议。

sentences.en: And in this case, what has happened is that the HHS secretary, RFK Jr., has just made an announcement about what's going to happen
sentences.zh: 而在这种情况下，发生的事情是，HHS（卫生与公众服务部）部长小RFK刚刚就将要发生的事情发表了声明

sentences.en: without having gone through any of those previous formal steps where there's lots of discussion, lots of review.
sentences.zh: 而没有经历任何那些先前包含大量讨论、大量审查的正式步骤。

sentences.en: It's all public.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是公开的。

sentences.en: It's all documented.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是有据可查的。

sentences.en: And anybody can listen in and watch and look at the presentations and see the data.
sentences.zh: 任何人都可以旁听、观看、查看演示文稿并看到数据。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: A kind of a case is made, data is assembled, votes are taken kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是提出论点、汇编数据、进行投票之类的流程。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: The fact that RFK Jr.
sentences.zh: 小RFK

sentences.en: did this would seem to raise two possibilities.
sentences.zh: 这样做似乎引发了两种可能性。

sentences.en: The first is that he and those around him decided that all of this was inevitable.
sentences.zh: 第一种是，他和周围的人认为这一切都是不可避免的。

sentences.en: The government recommendations for COVID vaccines were going to get less and less strict over time and that he just wants to circumvent the process to get it there.
sentences.zh: 随着时间的推移，政府对新冠疫苗的建议将会越来越不严格，而他只是想绕过这个流程来达到目的。

sentences.en: The other possibility is that he kind of just hijacked the process and took it upon himself to issue recommendations
sentences.zh: 另一种可能性是，他有点直接劫持了这个流程，自行发布了建议

sentences.en: that would normally go through a careful, considered process filled with medical expertise.
sentences.zh: 而这些建议通常应该经过充满医疗专业知识的仔细、审慎的流程。

sentences.en: I mean, it would seem he did hijack the process in a way because there was really no reason to do it in quite this way that I can see
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，在某种程度上他似乎确实劫持了这个流程，因为据我所见，根本没有理由以这种特定的方式来做

sentences.en: or that any of the experts I've talked to can see.
sentences.zh: 或者说我交谈过的任何专家都没看出有这个理由。

sentences.en: Because really, we have been headed in this direction anyway.
sentences.zh: 因为事实上，我们无论如何都一直在朝着这个方向发展。

sentences.en: Advisors to the CDC have been talking about not having healthy kids get the COVID shot.
sentences.zh: CDC的顾问们一直在讨论不让健康的儿童接种新冠疫苗。

sentences.en: So in June, they were going to meet and vote on this exact issue.
sentences.zh: 因此在六月份，他们本要开会并就这个确切的问题进行投票。

sentences.en: If at that point they didn't do the thing he wanted, he could still have overruled them.
sentences.zh: 如果到那时他们没有做出他想要的举动，他仍然可以推翻他们的决定。

sentences.en: But to not even allow that discussion to happen, to not even allow those data to be public and discussed, that seems really strange to me.
sentences.zh: 但是，甚至不允许这种讨论发生，甚至不允许这些数据公开并被讨论，这在我看来真的很奇怪。

sentences.en: Well, let me challenge you on that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那我来对你的观点提出一点质疑。

sentences.en: I mean, so far in this administration, is that so strange?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，到目前为止在本届政府中，这真的很奇怪吗？

sentences.en: It is a presidency where decision-making is extremely centralized in a small group of people who make decisions, sometimes not based entirely on a formal process,
sentences.zh: 这是一个决策高度集中的总统任期，权力掌握在一小群人手中，他们做出决策有时并非完全基于正式流程

sentences.en: sometimes on instinct, but with a fair amount of confidence in the rightness of what they're doing.
sentences.zh: 有时凭借直觉，但对他们所做事情的正确性有着相当大的信心。

sentences.en: That's a fair point.
sentences.zh: 这倒是个中肯的观点。

sentences.en: You could say this is standard for parts of the Trump administration, at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 你可以说这至少是特朗普政府某些部门的常态。

sentences.en: And that's certainly how RFK Jr.
sentences.zh: 这当然也是小RFK

sentences.en: has acted, even with things like cuts to federal agencies and getting rid of entire departments within those agencies.
sentences.zh: 一直以来的行事风格，哪怕是对待削减联邦机构以及裁撤这些机构内部的整个部门等事情也是如此。

sentences.en: But the problem here is that the stakes are just very high.
sentences.zh: 但这里的问题在于，利害关系实在太重大了。

sentences.en: You know, when you look at an agency like the FDA or like the CDC, its credibility, its integrity is really, really heavily dependent on this kind of process.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当你审视像FDA或CDC这样的机构时，其信誉、其完整性在很大程度上严重依赖于这种流程。

sentences.en: It's very important for people to be able to see what led to the decisions.
sentences.zh: 对于人们来说，能够看到导致这些决策的原因是非常重要的。

sentences.en: It's very important for companies to know that because if you do this kind of decision-making that seems arbitrary and don't show your work,
sentences.zh: 对于公司来说，了解这一点也非常重要，因为如果你进行这种看似武断且不展示工作过程的决策，

sentences.en: the companies may just take their products elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 这些公司可能会把他们的产品带到别处去。

sentences.en: We don't know what will happen with other drugs and vaccines.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道其他药物和疫苗会发生什么。

sentences.en: It just opens the door to a lot of uncertainty about health, which is a very, very important part of our lives.
sentences.zh: 这只会给健康带来大量的不确定性，而健康是我们生活中非常非常重要的一部分。

sentences.en: And so the stakes, I think, being so high makes it very important that this not be treated like any other part of what the Trump administration does.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为利害关系如此重大，使得这绝不能像特朗普政府所做的任何其他事情那样对待。

sentences.en: Well, Apoorva, I'm curious if you think there's going to be meaningful opposition to these new recommendations, especially given the process that you just outlined
sentences.zh: 好吧，阿普尔瓦，我很好奇你是否认为这些新建议会遭到实质性的反对，考虑到你刚刚概述的流程

sentences.en: and the process that was bypassed.
sentences.zh: 以及被绕过的那个流程。

sentences.en: Could this produce lawsuits?
sentences.zh: 这会引发诉讼吗？

sentences.en: Could this produce medical establishments issuing contrary recommendations to the federal government, which in theory could create a whole lot of confusion?
sentences.zh: 这会不会导致医疗机构发布与联邦政府相反的建议，从理论上讲，这可能会造成巨大的混乱？

sentences.en: There's an absolute possibility of lawsuits, and I've already heard rumblings about it.
sentences.zh: 绝对有可能引发诉讼，而且我已经听到相关的风声了。

sentences.en: I mean, there's a process that legally they're required to do.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，法律规定他们必须走一个流程。

sentences.en: And when they skip those steps, it does open it up to the companies, for example, could sue saying that their products are now unfairly being limited to only some populations,
sentences.zh: 当他们跳过这些步骤时，确实会给公司留下把柄，例如公司可以起诉，称他们的产品现在被不公平地限制在仅供部分人群使用，

sentences.en: even though there's no safety data indicating that to be a problem.
sentences.zh: 尽管没有任何安全数据表明这是一个问题。

sentences.en: You know, there are individuals and organizations that could sue because they now can't access the vaccine when they want to.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，有些个人和组织可能会提起诉讼，因为他们现在无法在需要时获取疫苗。

sentences.en: And they could similarly argue that there are no safety reasons for them not to have the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 他们同样可以辩称，没有任何安全理由阻止他们接种疫苗。

sentences.en: And so there are lots of different ways this could go.
sentences.zh: 所以这可能会朝很多不同的方向发展。

sentences.en: And there are already efforts to have, you know, statements that clarify where the majority of the medical or public health establishment falls.
sentences.zh: 而且已经有人在努力发表声明，澄清大多数医疗或公共卫生机构的立场。

sentences.en: So, for example, there's now a vaccine integrity project, which is a bunch of experts who have banded together to offer what they think of as the more sane,
sentences.zh: 例如，现在有一个“疫苗完整性项目”，这是一群联合起来的专家，旨在提供他们所认为的更理智、

sentences.en: science-based stance on vaccines.
sentences.zh: 基于科学的疫苗立场。

sentences.en: And you're right, that when you have all those kinds of dissenting voices, it does create confusion.
sentences.zh: 你说得对，当你有所有这些不同的反对声音时，确实会造成混乱。

sentences.en: But what's really clear is when the government puts its weight behind one decision or another, it creates a lot of mistrust for the average person.
sentences.zh: 但很显然的是，当政府全力支持某个决定时，会对普通人产生极大的不信任感。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们来谈谈这个。

sentences.en: Vaccine use in this country is way, way down.
sentences.zh: 这个国家的疫苗使用率大幅下降。

sentences.en: You've talked about that on the show before.
sentences.zh: 你以前在节目里谈过这个。

sentences.en: I'm curious what you suspect is going to happen as a result of these recommendations with COVID vaccine uptake and, more broadly, vaccine uptake.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道，你猜想由于这些建议的发布，新冠疫苗的接种率以及更广泛的疫苗接种率将会发生什么变化？

sentences.en: Well, we've seen with other vaccines, for example, with measles, that, you know, when there is sort of public discussion about their concerns about safety
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们在其他疫苗（例如麻疹疫苗）上已经看到，当公众对它们的安全性存在担忧时

sentences.en: that are unfounded or questions raised about, you know, how long they're effective, it does have an impact on people's willingness to go get the vaccine.
sentences.zh: 这些担忧是毫无根据的，或者是对它们的有效期限提出质疑，这确实会影响人们接种疫苗的意愿。

sentences.en: And we're in the midst of multiple measles outbreaks in this country right now.
sentences.zh: 我们目前正处于国内多起麻疹疫情的爆发之中。

sentences.en: So when you damage public trust in vaccines, it's very easy to create those doubts, and it takes forever to regain the truSt.
sentences.zh: 因此，当你破坏公众对疫苗的信任时，产生这些疑虑是极其容易的，而要重新建立信任则需要花费极其漫长的时间。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But now with COVID, we could be facing a more immediate problem.
sentences.zh: 但现在对于新冠，我们可能会面临一个更迫在眉睫的问题。

sentences.en: Because last week, I mean, forget about this recommendation about, you know, what's included in the immunization schedule.
sentences.zh: 因为上周，我的意思是，先别管关于免疫接种时间表里包含什么内容的这项建议。

sentences.en: Last week, the FDA said that they may not even approve COVID vaccines at all for anybody who is not, you know, 65 plus or doesn't have some kind of underlying health condition.
sentences.zh: 上周，FDA表示，他们甚至可能根本不会批准任何非65岁以上或没有某种潜在健康状况的人接种新冠疫苗。

sentences.en: And so what that means is, you know, it's not just a question of whether it'll be covered by insurance and whether it'll be easily available.
sentences.zh: 所以这意味着，你知道的，这不仅仅是保险是否会报销以及是否能轻易获得的问题。

sentences.en: If we had a new COVID variant come through that was dangerous, and we are actually hearing
sentences.zh: 如果我们遭遇了一种危险的新冠变异株来袭，而我们确实听到了

sentences.en: some rumblings from Asia that there's a worrisome new variant around, we would have entire populations of people who are not eligible for the vaccine at all.
sentences.zh: 来自亚洲的一些风声，称周围出现了一种令人担忧的新冠变异株，我们将面临整个人群根本不符合疫苗接种资格的情况。

sentences.en: So in a world where COVID returns with a vengeance, which could happen, it might not happen, under this administration, the lack of government recommendations for vaccines,
sentences.zh: 因此，在一个新冠卷土重来的世界里（这可能会发生，也可能不会），在本届政府领导下，政府缺乏对疫苗的建议，

sentences.en: especially for healthy children, pregnant women, means more people are going to be vulnerable.
sentences.zh: 特别是不针对健康儿童和孕妇，意味着更多的人将变得脆弱易感。

sentences.en: And potentially, the lack of approval for the vaccines means fewer doses of vaccine at the ready.
sentences.zh: 潜在地，缺乏对疫苗的批准意味着随时可用的疫苗剂量将会减少。

sentences.en: That's the situation.
sentences.zh: 这就是目前的状况。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's the situation.
sentences.zh: 是的，这就是目前的状况。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's not as if people are clamoring to get the shots.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，并不是说人们都在吵着要打针。

sentences.en: I mean, the COVID shot that was offered last fall, only about 13% of kids got it and about
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，去年秋天提供的新冠疫苗，只有大约13%的儿童接种了，大约有

sentences.en: 14% of pregnant women.
sentences.zh: 14%的孕妇接种了。

sentences.en: But the difference is that the choice was there.
sentences.zh: 但区别在于，当时还有选择的余地。

sentences.en: If somebody felt like they needed the vaccine for whatever reason, they could go get it.
sentences.zh: 如果有人出于某种原因觉得自己需要疫苗，他们就可以去接种。

sentences.en: Again, other countries have stopped recommending kids get the COVID vaccine.
sentences.zh: 再次强调，其他国家已经停止建议儿童接种新冠疫苗。

sentences.en: But in those countries, the vaccine is still approved for kids.
sentences.zh: 但在那些国家，疫苗仍然批准给儿童使用。

sentences.en: So if the situation were to change dramatically, they could still get it.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果情况发生剧烈变化，他们仍然可以接种。

sentences.en: What we're saying in this country is the kids shouldn't get it at all.
sentences.zh: 我们在这个国家所说的是，儿童根本不应该接种。

sentences.en: Of course, time will tell whether COVID ever returns with real ferocity.
sentences.zh: 当然，时间会证明新冠是否会以真正的猛烈势头卷土重来。

sentences.en: And if it doesn't, this new recommendation might seem, to many, quite reasonable.
sentences.zh: 如果它没有卷土重来，对许多人来说，这个新建议可能显得相当合理。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, it feels like the meaning of what happened on Tuesday is that the Trump administration's overall approach to vaccines, putting less emphasis on them,
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，周二发生的事情的意义在于，特朗普政府对疫苗的整体方针（降低对疫苗的重视程度，

sentences.en: questioning whether they have been too widely recommended.
sentences.zh: 质疑疫苗是否被过于广泛地推荐）。

sentences.en: That is now official government policy.
sentences.zh: 这现在已经成为了官方的政府政策。

sentences.en: And I was struck, and I wonder if you were, Apoorva, by the very last line of the video that was put out on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 我感到很震惊，不知道你是不是也一样，阿普尔瓦，对周二发布的那个视频的最后一句台词。

sentences.en: And the quote was that ending the existing recommendations for children, for pregnant women, brings the United States, quote,
sentences.zh: 引文提到，取消现有的针对儿童和孕妇的建议，使美国距离……引用结束……

sentences.en: quote, one step closer to realizing President Trump's promise to make America healthy again.
sentences.zh: 引用结束，距离兑现特朗普总统让美国再次健康的承诺又近了一步。

sentences.en: And it felt notable that the government's health agencies were articulating this idea that not getting a vaccine was part of making America healthy again.
sentences.zh: 而且令人瞩目的是，政府卫生机构正在阐明这样一个观点：不接种疫苗也是让美国再次健康的一部分。

sentences.en: I think it's going to be very hard for them to argue that pregnant women who are at high risk of COVID are somehow better off or healthier for not getting a vaccine.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们很难辩称，面临新冠高风险的孕妇不接种疫苗反而会更好或更健康。

sentences.en: I think there are more solid ground when it comes to kids, but still the implication does seem to be that the vaccine is somehow harming the health of these kids.
sentences.zh: 我认为在儿童问题上他们的立场更站得住脚，但暗示疫苗在某种程度上损害了这些孩子的健康，这种意味依然存在。

sentences.en: And that's very much in keeping with what RFK Jr.
sentences.zh: 这与小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪

sentences.en: has been saying for a lot of different vaccines.
sentences.zh: 针对许多不同疫苗一直在说的观点非常吻合。

sentences.en: He's falsely accused many vaccines of being unsafe and dangerous.
sentences.zh: 他曾毫无根据地指责许多疫苗不安全、很危险。

sentences.en: And it does seem to portend more decisions along these lines that say it's healthier to not get vaccines than it is to get them.
sentences.zh: 这确实预示着未来可能会做出更多类似决定，即认为不接种疫苗比接种疫苗更健康。

sentences.en: Well, Apoorva, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，阿普尔瓦，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, a federal judge struck down President Trump's executive order seeking to punish the law firm WilmerHale by restricting its access to the federal government.
sentences.zh: 周二，一名联邦法官驳回了特朗普总统旨在通过限制联邦政府业务来惩罚威默黑尔律师事务所的行政命令。

sentences.en: It was the third time that a judge has ruled that Trump's actions against law firms, including Perkins Coie and Jenner and Block, were unconstitutional.
sentences.zh: 这是法官第三次裁定特朗普针对律师事务所（包括佩金斯科伊律所以及简纳白克律所）的行动违宪。

sentences.en: Those rulings have validated the strategy embraced by some law firms to fight Trump rather than strike deals with him, as many big law firms have done,
sentences.zh: 这些裁决证实了一些律师事务所采取的战略：与特朗普斗争，而不是像许多大型律所那样与他达成妥协，

sentences.en: including Paul Weiss and Skadden Arps.
sentences.zh: 其中包括保罗·韦斯律所和世达律所。

sentences.en: And
sentences.zh: 此外，

sentences.en: Bags fly free so ideas can be shared.
sentences.zh: 托运行李免费，方能分享创意。

sentences.en: Bags fly free because everyday people need everyday things.
sentences.zh: 托运行李免费，因为普通人需要日常用品。

sentences.en: Southwest Airlines, the only major carrier that still allowed passengers to check multiple bags for free, is ending that policy.
sentences.zh: 西南航空公司作为唯一一家仍允许乘客免费托运多件行李的大型航空公司，正在结束这一政策。

sentences.en: As of today, Southwest will begin charging $35 for one checked bag and $45 for a second.
sentences.zh: 从今天起，西南航空将开始对第一件托运行李收取35美元，对第二件收取45美元。

sentences.en: Southwest was so proud of the original policy that it trademarked the perk and built a series of commercials around the tagline
sentences.zh: 西南航空曾对最初的政策感到如此自豪，以至于它将这项福利注册了商标，并围绕这句广告语制作了一系列广告：

sentences.en: Bags fly free.
sentences.zh: “行李免费托运”。

sentences.en: At Southwest, we fly your bags for free because we believe low fares should never mean low service.
sentences.zh: 在西南航空，我们为您免费托运行李，因为我们坚信低票价绝不意味着低服务。

sentences.en: But the airline's financial picture has soured, and as a result, it's now joining its competitors in charging for checked bags.
sentences.zh: 但该航空公司的财务状况已经恶化，因此它现在加入竞争对手的行列，开始对托运行李收费。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Eric Krupke and Asta Chaturvedi.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由埃里克·克鲁普克和阿斯塔·查图尔维迪制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Liz O'Baley, contains original music by Pat McCusker, and was engineered by Alyssa Moxley.
sentences.zh: 节目由莉兹·奥巴利剪辑，包含帕特·麦卡斯克创作的原创音乐，并由阿丽莎·莫克斯利进行音频工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由吉姆·布伦伯格和旺德利的本·兰斯伯格创作。

sentences.en: That's it for today.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目就到这里。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Bobarro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴博罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了大批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党陷入了一场残酷、混乱且有时令人热血沸腾的权力斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在由我萨拉·科尼格主持的最新一期《都市》节目中，我们将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
